rationale: B wins because it finds the cleaner product story A leaves on the table: "The $3.6 Billion Wearable That Still Needs a Blood Pressure Cuff" is a real consumer-tech angle from the supplied facts. A wastes one slot on "Whoop's clinical features are also a pitch to its next investors," which is boardroom tea-leaf reading unless someone proves fundraising, exit prep, or investor demand. B has more overclaiming, but its best angles give a founder more usable press strategy.
gaps_in_A: "Whoop's clinical features are also a pitch to its next investors" overreads a valuation and premium-tier gate into an investor narrative. No current fundraising, exit plan, or investor pressure is in the update.
"ahead of a future round or exit" is speculative padding. The set admits it needs confirmation, which means the headline should not be carrying that claim yet.
"Whoop got its ECG cleared by the FDA. Its blood-pressure feature was designed to avoid that step." The regulatory contrast is good, but "designed to avoid" asserts intent the facts do not prove.
"four viable shapes exist across competitive, health-equity, venture, and regulatory beats" gives the venture angle too much status. It is viable only after proof, not before.
gaps_in_B: "Whoop Finally Has FDA-Cleared ECG. Apple Watch Has Had It for Years." The supplied facts say competitors already ship FDA-cleared ECG; they do not name Apple or establish timing. Good instinct, premature headline.

"Apple Watch includes ECG with hardware, no subscription gate" imports a competitor-pricing claim. The parenthetical says "confirm this," which is exactly why it should not be treated as a premise yet.
"When a device can detect a condition linked to stroke and heart failure" adds medical consequence context that is not in the update. True may still be unsourced; unsourced still gets cut.

"The wearable industry has spent years positioning cuffless blood pressure monitoring as the next frontier" is a trend claim with no evidence supplied. It may be reportable, but right now it is a borrowed rug under the angle.
